title: Reading the near face of a stack
question: The image shows a stack of identical small cubes. Most cubes are gray, and a few are red. The top row, from left to right, shows the isometric, front, and top views of the cube stack. Which of the bottom images is the Left View of the cube stack? Please choose from options A, B, C, or D. Each column is supported from below.

annotation.Question: The image shows a stack of identical small cubes. Most cubes are gray, and a few are red. The top row, from left to right, shows the isometric, front, and top views of the cube stack. Which of the bottom images is the Left View of the cube stack? Please choose from options A, B, C, or D.

Explanation.B: Option B is incorrect because it is the Right View of the cube stack, not the Left View.
Explanation.A: Option A is incorrect because the position of the red cube in the view is incorrect.
Explanation.C: Option C is incorrect because it shows the Right View shape, not the Left View, and the position of the red cube is also incorrect.
